summary: Switzerland (CH) localization of Business Central 29. It covers Swiss electronic payments (QR-bill, ESR, LSV+, DTA, SEPA), the Swiss VAT statement with VAT exchange rate adjustment, delivery reminders, foreign-currency G/L balances, and Swiss sales quote and purchase document features.
overview:
The Swiss layer is built mostly around payments. It adds QR-bill codeunits, setup pages and enums (codeunits 11502 to 11519, pages 11510 to 11518), ESR (codeunit 3010531), DTA (codeunit 3010541) and LSV (codeunit 3010831) objects. It also extends the SEPA credit transfer and direct debit export and the CAMT 053/054 import. Bank accounts, journal lines and purchase headers gain fields such as Payment Form, ESR Type, Giro Account No., Reference No. and ESR/ISR Coding Line. Learn documents QR-bill management, ESR, LSV+ and clearing number import.

For tax and finance, the code adds VAT cipher fields to VAT statement lines and VAT posting setup. It also adds FCY and exchange-rate fields on VAT Entry, G/L Account and G/L Entry, and extends the Exch. Rate Adjustment report with valuation method and VAT entry adjustment. Learn describes the Swiss VAT statement, VAT exchange rates, temporary journal balances and Swiss general ledger accounts.

The layer also adds delivery reminders for vendors (codeunits 5005270 to 5005274, pages 5005270 to 5005283), physical inventory order tables, sales quote management (codeunit 3010801 with quote fields on sales header and line) and many "SR" reports. Part of the code is shared with the DACH region, such as data export and the Austrian and German VAT reports.
key_points: QR-bill: generation on posted sales and service invoices, scanning and import, IBAN and QR-IBAN, structured and combined address types, SWICO billing information, setup wizard.
ESR and LSV+: ESR reference numbers on journal lines and purchase headers, ESR file import into cash receipt journals, LSV journal with collection suggestion, close/reopen and file export.
SEPA changes: Swiss payment form and payment type on Payment Export Data, Swiss SEPA CT and DD export files, CAMT 053 and 054 import, and bank clearing number import through the Bank Directory.
Swiss VAT: VAT Statement Cipher on VAT statement lines, Sales and Purch. VAT Stat. Cipher on VAT Posting Setup, VAT exchange rates, and adjustment of VAT entries in the exchange rate batch job.
Delivery reminders for vendors: terms, levels, text, vendor codes, create manually or generate, test report, issue, with pages 5005270 to 5005283.
Foreign-currency G/L balances (Balance (FCY), Currency Code on G/L Account) and a provisional balance page for journals.
Sales quote management: probability, follow-up date, quote variants, titles and subtotals on sales lines, archived with the quote.
Swiss reports: vendor payments list, sales picking list, customer and vendor totals, item ABC analysis, and Import Post Codes.

areas.what: Adds the full Swiss payment toolset: QR-bill encode, decode, image, scan, billing info and setup pages, plus ESR, DTA and LSV management codeunits and setup pages. Extends SEPA credit transfer fill and check logic with Swiss payment form and type, adds Swiss SEPA CT and DD export, CAMT 053 and 054 import, and a Bank Directory page.
areas.why: Learn describes Swiss electronic payments as QR-bills, ESR, LSV+ direct debit and SEPA credit transfers, with clearing numbers imported from a bank directory file.

areas.what: Adds VAT and exchange-rate fields to VAT Entry and G/L Account. It extends the exchange rate adjustment with valuation method and VAT entry adjustment, and adds ESR and payment fee fields to journal lines. It also adds VAT cipher setup, a provisional trial balance and the DACH data export objects.
areas.why: Learn explains that Swiss VAT uses official exchange rates for foreign currency sales, and that the adjustment batch job runs before VAT statements. It also documents foreign currency G/L balances and temporary journal balances.

areas.what: Vendor Bank Account gets Swiss payment fields (payment form, ESR type, clearing no., giro and ESR account). Purchase Header gets ESR reference fields. Adds the delivery reminder feature with tables, pages, issue and create codeunits, and payment suggestion changes for summarized payments.
areas.why: Learn documents delivery reminders for overdue vendor deliveries, with terms, levels, text and vendor codes.

areas.what: Adds quote management to sales documents: probability, follow-up and decision dates, quote variants, titles, subtotals and classification on lines and archives. Sales subforms get formatting procedures, and posting codeunits get a posting-description event. Adds customer payment list and ranking reports.
areas.why: Learn lists subtotals in quotes and orders, Begin Total and End Total line types, and invoice rounding with payment discounts.

areas.what: Adds physical inventory order and recording tables, places of dispatcher and receiver, and fields on Item and Item Ledger Entry such as customer no. and inventory price. Adds Swiss item reports such as ABC analysis, ranking and inventory value.
areas.why: Learn mentions detailed reporting, multi-shipment tracking and default location codes for Swiss inventory.

areas.what: Company Information gets Swiss fields such as tax office and authorized numbers. Adds DACH report selection, Format Address changes and Swiss SEPA initialization codes. Post Code gets a Priority field, with an Import Post Codes report.
areas.why: Learn covers importing Swiss post codes from CSV or ZIP files from Swiss Post.

areas.what: Fixed Asset gets depreciation fields (BWR book code, premium depreciation). Adds a book value report and an Austrian fixed assets list, and FA General Report can exclude reclassification entries.
Adds delivery reminder permission set extensions and changes the LOCAL and LOCAL READ sets and two payables journal sets.
Service lines, invoice lines and archive lines get Swiss extensions. A service document codeunit supports QR-bill on service invoices.
areas.why: Learn states QR-bills can be generated on posted sales and service invoices.

areas.what: Read Data Exch. from File gets XML helper procedures to split payments per invoice and read amount nodes, used for Swiss bank file import.
Archive management gets procedures to archive sales documents with quote status. A general management codeunit is added.

issues: The overview's range 'codeunits 11502 to 11519' for QR-bill objects is slightly loose. It also takes in non-QR codeunits CHMgt (11503) and CH Report Management (11515), and there are no codeunits numbered 11505 to 11511. This is minor, and the QR-bill codeunits themselves are correctly placed inside the range.

Saying that data export and the Austrian and German VAT reports are 'shared with the DACH region' is an inference. It fits the objects in the input (VAT Statement AT, VAT Statement Germany, Update VAT-AT, the Data Export objects and the DACH-named objects), and it is reasonable.

The key point on Swiss reports includes Customer Total-Balance and Vendor Total-Balance (11003/11004). These sit in the DACH-style number range rather than the CH range, but they are objects of the country's own, so calling them local reports holds up.
